name: underground-garage-catwoman
image_purpose: Cosplay and alternative fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create an incidental snapshot-style cosplay fashion portrait in a concrete parking garage, inspired by cat motifs without depicting a named copyrighted character.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long wavy dark reddish-auburn hair parted in the middle, dramatic but realistic makeup, confident direct gaze, and a neutral poised expression. She wears a full-coverage black form-fitting textured animal-pattern jumpsuit zipped securely to the collar, a matching cat-ear headband, black gloves with attached metallic claw tips, a wide black belt, and small silver hoop earrings. A black braided costume prop is held safely across the torso as a fashion accessory, not used as a weapon.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 eye-level medium shot cropped at the upper thighs, with the subject centered before a thick grey concrete pillar. Include the concrete ceiling, support beams, open garage levels and bright daylight from the rear right. Keep the pose confident and fashion-oriented, with no cleavage or intimate-area emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft flat natural daylight diffused through the open garage, gentle shadows under the chin and hair, controlled sheen on the textured synthetic suit, urban industrial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 amateur cosplay fashion snapshot, full-frame camera with 50mm lens, realistic skin texture and makeup, visible synthetic texture and concrete wear, mild depth falloff, no logos or watermark.
